title: Appraisal work in hand
subtitle: Read-only snapshot. Fictional demo records until your own import.

sections.title: Open assignments
sections.sql: select code,address,valuer,due_date,overdue_days,issues from work_queue where status='active' order by due_date nulls first,code

sections.title: Checks needing attention
sections.sql: select code,rule,issue from compliance_issues order by code,rule

sections.title: Weighted sales indications
sections.sql: select code,currency,comps,indicated_amount,conclusion_amount,conclusion_variance_pct from indications order by code
sections.note: Sales comparison only. Units are square metres. The valuer selects evidence, weights and adjustments. This is not an automated valuation.
